leverage.exposure: This is the item that outranks everything else. The outstanding offer exceeds the available balance, so if it is struck before the sale is completed the balance is negative at the moment the matchday starts, and a negative balance at matchday start scores zero for the entire matchday. That is the single largest loss available in the game right now and it is entirely avoidable with one instant sale. Note that the spending cap is not what binds here: the offer sits well inside the floor set against team value, so nothing prevents the bid from being struck. Only the negative-balance rule punishes it, and only afterwards. The window to repair it after the offer resolves is under two hours on a Friday evening, which is why the sale should be completed now rather than held for the marginally better price.

binding_gap: The binding gap is not a squad hole and not a formation hole. Every legal shape is fillable and the squad is comfortably above the eleven-player floor, so there is no penalty risk from the roster. The binding gap is cash: the outstanding offer is larger than the balance, and the difference has to be raised before the offer resolves. It has now been open and unfunded for five consecutive runs, and it is the only thing that matters this run. Nothing on the board needs buying to fix a positional gap.

verdict.headline: URGENT AND THE ACTION HAS CHANGED.
verdict.headline_short: URGENT AND THE ACTION HAS CHANGED.
verdict.detail: URGENT AND THE ACTION HAS CHANGED. Bernardo was put on the market as a manager ask shortly after the last briefing, and simultaneously dropped from the lineup. A manager ask is not a sale: it has no expiry, it needs a rival to choose to buy, and it has drawn no offers at all. The balance is therefore unchanged and the live Makengo offer is still unfunded, with under two hours until it resolves and under four until the matchday locks. If that offer is struck against an unfunded balance, the balance goes negative at matchday start and the entire matchday scores zero. Take Bernardo off the market and sell him to Kickbase at market value instead. That is instant, needs no counterparty, and pays market value to the euro, measured six times this week. The premium the manager ask would earn over market value is a rounding error against the tail it leaves open, and no rival has bid on it in nearly two hours. Do not raise the Makengo bid and do not withdraw it. The plan is unchanged and correct; only the instrument was wrong.

sell.reason: Bernardo, Hoffenheim left-back, is the sale, for the fifth consecutive run, and the arithmetic was brute-forced again this run at current market values across every listing, every legal one and two-player unwind, and all nine formations. He is the best single funding sale in the branch where the bid lands and the cheapest body to give up. Selling Lokonga instead is slightly better in the branch where the bid is missed but worse where it lands, and worse in expectation. Selling Widmer and Amoako together does not raise enough to cover the gap at all. Two things to be honest about. First, the sale is no longer free: he is a confirmed starter on the freshest sources, so this is a starter-for-starter upgrade, not the dumping of a benched man. Second, the instrument is the whole point of this briefing. Sell him to Kickbase, not to the market.

standing.name: Bernardo
standing.why: SELL HIM NOW, AND THIS REVERSES THE ORDERING OF THE THREE CALLS IT REPLACES (S6x53gy, Suill11, Sjvbavj - all closed this run). Those said: pre-sell AMOAKO now, then sell Bernardo inside the 16:33-18:30Z window. This says: pre-sell BERNARDO now and do nothing in the window. The switch is not a change of mind about which player - Bernardo was always the correct funding leg - it is a change about WHICH ACTION IS PRE-COMMITTED, and the reason is that the Amoako-first plan leaves TWO required actions inside a 1h57m Friday-evening window and the Bernardo-first plan leaves ZERO required actions. THE ARITHMETIC, RE-DONE AT THIS RUN'S NUMBERS AND WITH LINEUP RISK COUNTED, WHICH PREVIOUS RUNS OMITTED. Amoako is UNPLACED (no lo), so selling him is lineup-neutral: squad 11, placed 11, XI unchanged 1395. That is exactly why it looked free. But it leaves the funding gap open: Makengo resolves ~16:32Z at 9.000.000 against cash 4.187.522, and after the Amoako sale cash is 5.806.058, so landing him puts the balance at -3.193.942. Closing that then needs a SALE (Bernardo, who sits at lo 4) AND a LINEUP action (place Makengo into the vacated slot), both before 18:30Z, or the balance is negative at matchday start and MD2 scores ZERO. Bernardo-first inverts the risk: sell him now, cash 11.343.624, squad 11 = 1GK/4DEF/4MID/2ATT, and place Amoako into the vacated lo 4 immediately. Only 4-4-2 is legal and the XI is Baumann 129, Matsima 138, Widmer 29, Minjae 110, ter Horst 143, Nusa 226, Lokonga 44, Onyeka 139, AMOAKO 0, Gregoritsch 195, Guirassy 180 = 1333. If Makengo lands, cash is 2.343.624, squad 12 = 1/5/4/2, and swapping Amoako out for Makengo in a 5-3-2 gives 1423. If Georg is outbid, nothing needs doing and 1333 stands. THE POINT IS THAT 1333 IS THE FLOOR WITH ZERO FURTHER ACTION, whereas the Amoako-first floor is ZERO if he misses the window. EV, with p = P(Makengo lands) and r = P(he sets the lineup in the window): Bernardo-first = 1333 + p*r*90; Amoako-first = p*q*1423 + (1-p)*1395 where q is P(both window actions done). At p=0.85 these cross at r=q=0.992 - Amoako-first wins ONLY at near-certainty of acting, and loses catastrophically otherwise. THE EVIDENCE ON WHETHER HE ACTS IS NOW NEGATIVE, AND THAT IS THE NEW INPUT THIS RUN: SELL Amoako has been the standing recommendation across FOUR runs as an instant, certain, zero-fielded-cost sale, and at 08:45:21Z it is STILL UNEXECUTED (get_squad returns Amoako, mv 1618536). Whatever the reason, an unexecuted zero-cost action is not evidence for assuming a time-critical sale plus a lineup change will happen between 18:33 and 20:30 CEST on a Friday. Take the insurance. COST STATED HONESTLY, unchanged from H08gr86: if Makengo is outbid, 1333 vs the 1395 he has today = MINUS 62, unrecoverable because Makengo is the LAST pre-lock resolver on the board. That is the premium paid to remove a ~1400-point tail. NEAR-TIE ALTERNATIVE, RECORDED SO A FUTURE RUN DOES NOT THINK IT WAS MISSED: selling LOKONGA now instead (mv 9707930, ap 44 - LOWER than Bernardo's 62) gives squad 11 = 1/5/3/2, 5-3-2 legal, floor 1351 (better than 1333) and ceiling 1412 (worse than 1423), and leaves 4.895.452 cash after Makengo instead of 2.343.624 while dumping the squad's worst points-per-euro asset (221k/point, mvt 2, sdmvt -1.192.795) and keeping a rising one (Bernardo mvt 1, tfhmvt +107.550). EV at p=0.85: Bernardo 1409.5 vs Lokonga 1402.9 at r=1, but Lokonga EDGES AHEAD at r<=0.7 (1387.3 vs 1386.6). The two are within ~7 points across the plausible range. Bernardo is recommended because it is consistent with four runs of settled arithmetic, sells the rising asset into strength, and wins if the lineup does get set; but a Georg who will NOT touch the app again today should prefer Lokonga for the better floor and the extra 2,55M. Do NOT treat this paragraph as a licence to churn the call next run on a sub-10-point margin. FITNESS, VERIFIED THIS RUN AND IT IS NOT A DISPOSAL: Ligainsider's Verletzte-und-Gesperrte table at 08:50Z reads "Derzeit keine verletzten oder gesperrten Spieler" for TSG Hoffenheim - zero entries, so Bernardo is not on it, and neither is any other squad player. His Kickbase st 2 / stl [2] is dt 2026-08-31T14:40:12Z, now ~90h old and unchanged; it is stale data, NOT a live injury, and must not be push-notified. Four sources dated 03.09.2026 start him at left-back v Dortmund. He is a fit confirmed starter sold for cash and a better slot.

Four independent sources dated 03.09.2026 put him back in the starting eleven at LEFT-BACK for Hoffenheim v Dortmund (Sat 05.09.2026 13:30Z) with Hranac absent from the eleven in all four: bundesliga.com MD2 probable teams; Yahoo Sports preview 03.09.2026 13:45Z (unavailable list Prass and Asllani only); magazin.comunio.de 03.09.2026; thehardtackle.com 03.09.2026 16:26. Ligainsider profile 03.09.2026 shows the green Fit flag, latest news 28.08.2026 "Bernardo meldet sich fuer Koeln zurueck", and he is absent from the 03.09.2026 Verletzte-und-Gesperrte table. Hoffenheim's squad page lists him as Linksverteidiger while Hranac and Hajdari are Innenverteidiger, so the MD1 substitution at 53' was positional, not a demotion. HE IS STILL A RECOMMENDED SALE (see SELL S06z2dd) but on ENTIRELY DIFFERENT GROUNDS: he is the only funding route for the live 9.000.000 Makengo offer that resolves ~2026-09-04T16:27Z against cash of 4.107.522, and leaving it unfunded means a negative balance at matchday start and zero points for MD2. The swap is ap 62 out for ap 90 in, +28 fielded, not the +90 the old entry implied. Two dead ends for future runs: hoffenheim.de no longer 403s, it 302-redirects to sinsheim.de/hoffenheim/geschichte and is permanently useless; and the Ligainsider Hoffenheim probable-XI page has NOT refreshed, still reading "Letzte Aktualisierung: Vor 2 Tagen | 31.08.2026 15:45". Unresolved: Kickbase still carries st 2 / stl [2] timestamped 2026-08-31T14:40:12Z, now ~74h old and unchanged - stale, contradicted by the 03.09 sources, and NOT to be notified on. The comunio.de 16.04.2026 item and the undated fotmob prediction remain traps and must not be re-cited.
blocked.reversal: He is a probable starter again, so the benching case for never re-buying him is GONE. If he is ever relisted after this sale, judge him on ordinary merits rather than on this entry: re-verify his fitness (the st 2 question is genuinely open) and require the ask at or below mv, plus a squad slot he would actually improve - his ap 62 is below every fielded outfielder in the current eleven except Widmer's 29. Do not re-buy him merely because a source says he starts; that is now known and is not new information.
